integrity: The result concerns a proved analytic formula, supplemented by 480 finite replay assertions. Earlier uniform-size common-price windmill and three-vertex triangle special cases are not claimed as new; complete historical literature coverage is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: One common hub; k at least two cliques, each with at least two peripheral vertices; independent nonnegative edge conductances with two positive per-edge cost classes per blade; one linear budget; unnormalized sum of unordered-pair resistances. No assertion for arbitrary per-edge prices, other topologies, nonlinear costs, or independent audit.
title: Exact mixed-support conductance design for heterogeneous clique bouquets
